name: Hadron-Elektron-Ring-Anlage
notes: The per-species beam energies (27.5 GeV for e⁻/e⁺, 920 GeV for protons) are sourced to the existing Wikipedia citation plus a DESY-hosted page (desy.de/~ameyer/hq/node16.html, a physicist's teaching notes on the desy.de domain, which is secondary rather than DESY's own institutional page). Both agree on 27.5/920 GeV and on the 320 GeV cms energy already recorded; confidence stays uncertain because no official source was consulted for these two numbers specifically (checked 2026-09-17).

beam_energy.note: Sourced to Wikipedia plus a DESY-hosted lecture-notes page (read from the Internet Archive capture 20250222113620 because the live host resets connections); both are secondary, so confidence stays uncertain until an official DESY accelerator-complex page is found. The quote is the Wikipedia sentence; the DESY-hosted page words the same values as "collides 27.5 GeV electrons or positrons with 920 GeV protons".
